blurb: Guests join snorkeling and wildlife tours on a 40ft USCG certified boat with shade, warm fresh water shower, and marine head. Tours explore the Kona coast and open ocean to observe and swim with marine life including dolphins, whales, manta rays, and turtles. Safety is prioritized with experienced, Lifeguard+CPR certified crew and limited group sizes for comfort.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours prior to departure for full refund; no refund if less than 48 hours · Payment required at time of booking for all trips · Sunlight On Water reserves right to refuse service due to health or safety reasons · If captain cancels due to severe weather, will reschedule or refund · No guarantee of manta rays, dolphins, or whales sightings; no refunds for no sightings · Use of only reef-safe sunscreen is mandatory
